shoreditchadmin2

In this video John Ross joins India & Global Left to discuss the recent US-China summit, Trump’s evolving China strategy, Russia-China relations and the changing global geopolitical order.

What is the Trump administration trying to achieve in its approach toward China and Russia?

Is Washington seeking to separate Russia from China, and what would that mean for the emerging international system?

Also discussed is whether the world is entering a new Cold War II, why the current confrontation differs from the original Cold War, and why stability remains an important feature of the present global situation.

John Ross also examines the changing security landscape in East Asia, the strategic implications of US-China competition, and why Europe faces an increasingly difficult strategic environment.
